verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents recurring invoices at regular intervals and scheduling invoices to send on a chosen date. That gives basic control over billing cycles and custom invoice dates, but nothing covers anchor semantics. missing for 10: calendar vs anniversary billing choice, alignment of billing dates across a customer's multiple subscriptions, proration or anchor-reset controls, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can control billing anchors and cycles — calendar vs anniversary billing, alignment across a customer's subscriptions, custom invoice dates

citations.quote: Create recurring invoices for transactions that occur at regular intervals
Zoho Invoice lets you schedule your invoices to be automatically sent to your customers on the date you choose.
